# 🧪 Experiment Report

## Research question and method
One question, hypothesis, algorithm, assumptions, parameters and commit.

## Data and environment
Schema, source/generator, seed, splits, Python, packages and OS.

## Metrics and results
Define metrics. Record actual values, variability and failed runs.

## Interpretation and limitations
Whether evidence supports hypothesis, leakage risks and untested cases.

## Reproduction
Exact command and artifacts.
